summary: Current-candidate synthetic pressure passed: 50 queued requests with 200 MiB of held fixture buffers, separate count and 256 MiB waiting-byte overload rejection, metadata-only pages of 25 rows, 1000 timed queries and sampled RSS. Cleanup returns waiting bytes to zero. Body-budget overload/cleanup fixtures and UI pagination also passed. This does not establish real browser concurrency or a hard RSS limit.

pressure.notes: Synthetic in-memory scheduler pressure; observed RSS is sampled process memory, separate from waiting-byte accounting and the independent HTTP allocation estimate. Not real browser concurrency.
